sentences.text: The in-force UCB directions require that floating-rate loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 to individual borrowers for purposes other than business must not have pre-payment charges, but that wording does not cover a loan sanctioned on December 31, 2025 itself.

The in-force UCB directions also require that floating-rate loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026 to individual borrowers for purposes other than business must not have pre-payment charges, but that wording also does not cover a loan sanctioned on December 31, 2025.
The earlier RBI directions on floating-rate term loans were superseded, and the 2025 RBI pre-payment-charge directions were later withdrawn, so they are not in force for this date.

No in-force rule shown here squarely covers a floating-rate home loan to an individual sanctioned on December 31, 2025, so the evidence does not support a definitive yes-or-no answer for that exact date.
